title: B1: remove board-games sync CronWorkflow (chart + cluster)
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/2026-09-05_16-34-obsidian-down-last-good-cache.md — Workstream B, step 3 (epic tk-vau).

Delete the CronWorkflow `board-games-sync-cron` (chart/templates/workflow.yaml lines defining spec.schedules '*/5 * * * *' + workflowSpec.workflowTemplateRef) from the chart, and `kubectl -n board-games delete cronworkflow board-games-sync-cron` at apply time (cluster: talos, KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config-dell01, endpoint 192.168.68.91:6443).

Keep the WorkflowTemplate, EventSource, Sensor and RBAC — they are the push path. Keep the sync mutex: it serializes overlapping sensor-triggered runs.

NOTE: obsidian-vault-sync also runs on its own 5-min cron in the obsidian namespace (epoch-named runs every 300s) — until that side goes webhook-only too, syncs remain periodic under a different name. Handled in B2's scope (obsidian infra).
notes: Chart: CronWorkflow block deleted from chart/templates/workflow.yaml (renders 0 CronWorkflows, helm lint clean, all other docs intact — 1 WorkflowTemplate here + pre-existing gen-box-art one). Cluster: kubectl delete succeeded but ArgoCD selfHeal resurrected it within minutes (git HEAD still has it) — expected and actually CORRECT until deploy: the deployed sensor is still inert (old exact-match filter) so the cron is prod's only sync path today. Permanent removal = ArgoCD prune on next chart sync after push (tracked in D1 verify step 3: 'cronworkflow list empty').
acceptance_criteria: helm template output no longer contains the CronWorkflow; kubectl -n board-games get cronworkflow returns empty; no new board-games-sync-cron-* workflows appear over the following hour.

Resolution: merge to main -> ArgoCD prunes the CronWorkflow itself -> verify empty (folded into post-merge/D1 verification). Status stays ready-to-review pending user hunk review.
